mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to accommodative monetary policy supporting equity valuations and reducing risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level < 0.5% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 500.0) signals a deteriorating housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness and thus predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST < 500.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals a recessionary environment, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND UNRATE > 8.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0), which signals a weakening economy, the S&P 500 is expected to have negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO < 90.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 380.0) signals strong consumer demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to robust corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 380.0, or the Rank IC for RSAFS > 380.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 225.0) signals a potential for monetary tightening, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased interest rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 225.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining employment (PAYEMS < 130.0) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and increased economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 130.0 AND UNRATE > 8.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
